patches.title: Open Then Take
patches.principle: Always open a container before trying to take an object from it.
patches.when_to_apply: When you need to retrieve an object from a closed container.

patches.title: Close Empty Containers
patches.principle: After finding no target in an open container, close it to avoid confusion.
patches.when_to_apply: When a container is open and empty.

patches.title: Same-Type Exhaustion
patches.principle: Search all containers of the same type before switching to a different type.
patches.when_to_apply: When you have started searching a particular container type.
